apps.name: Brave
apps.tagline: Brave, running on your server and streamed to any device
apps.description:
A full Brave browser, with its built-in ad and tracker blocking, that runs on your server and streams to your phone, tablet or computer, powered by Neko (WebRTC). Your profile, bookmarks, passwords and extensions stay on your server, and downloads land in Home → Downloads.

Works on your home network and over Tailscale. It does not stream through a Cloudflare tunnel, because the video uses WebRTC on ports 52250-52259 (UDP) of your server. For access through Cloudflare, install "Brave (HTTPS)" instead.

Omarchy Server’s sign-in protects this app; anyone who can sign in to your server can use this browser as you. x86-64 (amd64) only.
apps.releaseNotes: First release: Neko 3.2.0 with Brave, a personal-browser policy (sync, bookmarks, passwords, extensions and downloads allowed), and downloads saved to Home → Downloads.

apps.name: Brave (HTTPS)
apps.tagline: Brave on your server, streamed over a secure connection
apps.description:
The Brave browser running on your server, streamed to your device by linuxserver.io's Selkies. Your profile stays on your server, and downloads land in Home → Downloads.

Needs a secure page: Selkies uses browser features (WebCodecs) that only work on https:// pages. Omarchy Server opens it over https:// with its own certificate. The first time, your browser may warn about the certificate; trust this server in Settings → Secure connection to stop the warning.

The container is hardened to be a browser only: no terminal, no sudo, no remote commands and no sidebar file transfers. Omarchy Server’s sign-in protects this app; anyone who can sign in to your server can use this browser as you.
apps.releaseNotes: First release: linuxserver/brave 1.99.56-ls145 (Selkies), hardened to a browser-only desktop, with downloads saved to Home → Downloads.
